title: What they said at the time

clips.q: FilmStruck is a terrific example of our strategy to meet consumer demand for great content across all screens.
clips.who: **John Martin**, chairman and CEO of Turner, press release, Apr 2016[^1]

clips.q: We’ve had a great five years at Hulu, but the opportunity to build our own channel with the help of an incredible team like the one at TCM is a dream come true for our company.
This is a new way for us to experiment and maybe take some risks that I wouldn’t want to take with a gem of a treasured brand such as TCM.
A new generation of film nerds will be raised on it.
clips.who: **The Guardian**, on the British launch, Feb 18, 2018[^11]

clips.q: But after sitting down and looking at it, rather than having two overlapping services going after the same audience, we decided to combine them.
clips.who: **Craig Hunegs**, on closing Warner Archive into FilmStruck, Variety, Feb 26, 2018[^12]

clips.q: While FilmStruck has a very loyal fanbase, it remains largely a niche service.
clips.who: **Turner and Warner Bros. Digital Networks**, statement, Oct 26, 2018[^19]

clips.q: Like many of you, we are disappointed by this decision.
The closing of FilmStruck is a bracing reminder that corporations have no particular commitment to art, even when they own it.
FilmStruck is not just a niche market, it is a massive archive dedicated to keeping art of the past alive, much in the way a museum keeps artists from centuries ago alive.
The FilmStruck service was (IS) the best streaming service for fans of cinema of all kinds: classic studio movies, independent cinema, international treasures.
clips.who: **Paul Thomas Anderson, Christopher Nolan, Barbra Streisand and 18 others**, letter to Toby Emmerich, published by Deadline, Nov 14, 2018[^26]

clips.q: I don’t know if it will do anything, but we have to at least try.
FilmStruck was a niche service. It never tried to be anything but.
But it still stung when faced with the reality that, at the push of a button, a corporation could make our Ozu disappear.
